top_story: Washington’s pivot on 20 August from recent strikes to a coercive sanctions campaign against Iran, including threats against Tehran’s trade partners, drew a defiant response from Iranian leaders on 21 August and hardened the risk of wider economic disruption across already fragile regional markets. Israel’s 20 August admission that its soldiers fired on the car in which five-year-old Hind Rajab and six relatives were killed, followed by a criminal investigation, sharpened pressure over civilian harm in Gaza and reinforced the war’s enduring social trauma.
